comparison.objective: Separate two nested trays and park each upright in its marked bay.
comparison.physical_skill: Tab grasping, vertical denesting before lateral motion, and stable placement.
comparison.success_condition: Trays released, separated by at least 10 mm, centered within 20 mm of their bays with tilt/yaw limits, stable for two seconds.
comparison.reason: Rigid-container denesting and placement do not test tool alignment, controlled impact fracture, preservation of a retained threaded insert, or small-fragment recovery.
